comment: Automation surface (F4): App Intents and App Shortcuts (Sources/Automation/AutomationIntents.swift, docs/automation.md)
keys: Applies one of the Fan Control profiles. Fan Control must be turned on in Settings.
Hands every fan back to the system's automatic control.
Starts a countdown timer in the notch.
Keeps the Mac awake, or lets it sleep again. The Keep Awake widget must be in the Nook.
Starts (or resumes) the Focus / Pomodoro timer. The Focus widget must be in the Nook.
Lets dynamicnotch://capture URLs and dnctl take screenshots. Any app on this Mac can open these URLs, so leave this off unless you use them.
